Klepni na některý swing high: svíčku na: Tap one of the swing highs: the candle at the top from which price turned down.
Swing high má po obou stranách svíčky s: A swing high has candles with a lower high on both sides. There are two here, the second is higher than the first.
Klepni na některý swing low: svíčku na d: Tap one of the swing lows: the candle at the bottom from which price turned up.
Swing low má po obou stranách svíčky s v: A swing low has candles with a higher low on both sides. The second low is higher than the first, which is why this is an uptrend.
Která svíčka udělala BOS, tedy zavřela n: Which candle made the BOS, that is closed above the last high?
BOS je zavření těla nad posledním vrchol: A BOS is a body close above the last high in the trend's direction. The candles before it stayed below the line.
Která svíčka udělala MSS, tedy první zav: Which candle made the MSS, that is the first close against the trend?
MSS je zavření pod posledním vyšším dnem: An MSS is a close below the last higher low. It is the first warning that the uptrend is breaking.
Která svíčka udělala sweep, tedy vybrala: Which candle made the sweep, that is took the stops above the highs and came back?
Knot vyletěl nad equal highs, ale svíčka: The wick flew above the equal highs, but the candle closed back below the level. That is a sweep, not a breakout.
Klepni na svíčku, která po sobě nechala: Tap the candle that left a bullish FVG behind.
FVG tvoří velká prostřední svíčka. Mezer: The FVG is made by the large middle candle. The gap lies between the high of the candle before it and the low of the candle after it.
Která svíčka se vrátila do středu mezery: Which candle returned to the middle of the gap?
Tahle svíčka sáhla knotem na 50 % mezery: This candle reached 50 % of the gap with its wick. That is where ICT looks for a buy.
Klepni na svíčku, která po sobě nechala: Tap the candle that left a bearish FVG behind.
Velká klesající svíčka uprostřed. Mezera: The large down candle in the middle. The gap lies between the low of the candle before it and the high of the candle after it.
Která svíčka zavřela tělem pod mezerou a: Which candle closed with its body below the gap and turned it into an inverse FVG?
Teprve zavření celého těla pod mezerou m: Only a close of the whole body below the gap changes its role. The candle before it only entered the gap.
Která svíčka je bullish order block?: Which candle is the bullish order block?
Bullish order block je poslední klesajíc: A bullish order block is the last down candle before a strong rally.
Klepni na svíčku, která patří k displace: Tap a candle that belongs to the displacement, that is the strong move up.
Displacement jsou velké svíčky jedním sm: Displacement is large candles in one direction right after the order block. Without it the order block would have no weight.
Která svíčka je bearish order block?: Which candle is the bearish order block?
Bearish order block je poslední rostoucí: A bearish order block is the last up candle before a strong drop.
Která svíčka zavřela nad order blockem a: Which candle closed above the order block and turned it into a breaker?
Order block selhal ve chvíli, kdy nad ní: The order block failed the moment a candle closed above it with its body. Since then it works as support.
CISD je zavření těla nad otevírací cenou: A CISD is a body close above the opening price of the last run of down candles. The candle before it still closed below the line.
Která svíčka srovnala nerovnováhu hned,: Which candle evened out the imbalance right away, so that no FVG formed?
Její knot se vrátil přesně k high svíčky: Its wick returned exactly to the high of the candle before the big move. That is called an immediate rebalance.
V celém setupu najdi svíčku, která vybra: In the whole setup find the candle that took the liquidity.
Knot nad posledním vrcholem vybral stopy: The wick above the last high took the stops and the candle closed back. That is where the setup starts.
A která svíčka potvrdila změnu struktury: And which candle confirmed the structure shift (MSS)?
A large candle closed below the last low. After the sweep it is the second step of the setup.
